steps.title: How it works,

conta.title: Create your account
conta.body: All you need is an email and a password.

email.title: Confirm your email
email.body: Open the link we send you. Only accounts with a confirmed email count.

acao.title: Do one thing in the platform
acao.body: For example, add a company to your watchlist. That’s how we know there’s a person on the other side.

steps.after: If you’re among the first {total}, we’ll email you asking for a shipping address.

offerSubtitle: The whole platform, nothing cut down. Only the AI analyst has a daily limit.

fundamentais.title: 10 years of fundamentals
fundamentais.body: Revenue, margins, free cash flow, debt and shares outstanding for all 500 S&P 500 companies, from the reports filed with the SEC.

avaliacao.title: Valuation
avaliacao.body: Today’s multiples next to each company’s own history, so you read the price in context.

dcf.title: Pre-filled DCF
dcf.body: The discounted cash flow model comes loaded with the company’s numbers. Change the assumptions and watch the intrinsic value move.

ia.title: AI analyst in Portuguese
ia.body: Summary, competitive advantages, catalysts and risks for each company, with a daily limit of analyses.

items.primeiros: Books go to the first {total} accounts that complete the three steps, first come, first served.
items.email: Only accounts with a confirmed email count.
items.acao: You need to do at least one thing in the platform, such as adding a company to your watchlist.
items.morada: We only ask winners for an address, by email. We never ask for it at sign-up.
items.fim: One book per person. The campaign ends when the books run out.

faq.title: Questions about the campaign
faq.q1: Who is giving away the books?
faq.a1: Economist Nuno Palma, author of “As Causas do Atraso Português”, offered {total} copies for this campaign.
faq.q2: How do I know if I won a book?
faq.a2: If you’re among the first {total} accounts to complete the three steps, we’ll email you asking for a shipping address. We only ask winners for an address.
faq.a3: One simple action inside the platform, for example adding a company to your watchlist.
faq.q4: How long does the campaign last?
faq.a4: Until the books run out. The counter on this page shows how many are left.
faq.q5: Does BullValue tell me what to buy?
faq.a5: No. We show data, valuation and calculations so you can study companies and decide for yourself. Nothing here is investment advice.
